note: $2,000 plan: 70% core beta / 20% ETF rotation / 10% paper sandbox. Only buy_hold sleeves are enabled here; signal sleeves are added with their own pre-registered rules.

sleeves.thesis: Top-3 long-only sector ETFs by 6-month momentum; cash when the best momentum is negative. Backtest evidence: reports/TACTICAL_ROTATION_EDGE_2026-07-04.md (top5-6m Sharpe 0.88 vs SPY 0.74, MaxDD -19% vs -51%, 2007-2026). Forward n=0 - this sleeve exists to create forward rows, not to size.
Control arm: 3 pseudo-random sector ETFs on the same rebalance dates. If etf-rotation cannot beat this, its momentum selection adds nothing.
